description: Pre-refactor synthetic saved populations, actual scoring and paired intervals. Only changing input/runtime hashes replaced by inventory markers; no frozen study recomputed.

driver.limitations: Historical source-backed strokes gained on hypothetical flat courses; carry treated as final lie, no roll or hazards; unsupported terminal lies are counted but cannot be scored. Intervals cover paired sampling, not model or course uncertainty.

width10_hole350.scenario: Historical PGA tee shot on a flat 350 m hole with a 20 m fairway corridor
width10_hole350.evaluation: Public Tools API scored each baseline knot; endpoint scores are exact piecewise-linear interpolation of those returned values
limitations: 2003-2010 PGA benchmark and approximate reconciled putting fit; not a current or player-specific estimate.
Flat hypothetical geometry; landing is treated as final lie with no roll, hazards, or recovery obstruction.
Bootstrap intervals include Monte Carlo sampling only, not club delivery, course, or model uncertainty.
